To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cis- and trans-l-2-aminoethyl cyclohexylammine platinum(II) complex are active against leukemia L12102.
trans-l- and especially cis-l-2-amino-methyl cyclohexylammine Pt (II) complexes have antitumor activity and the structures of the cis and the trans complexes are different.

cis- and trans-l-2-aminomethylcyclohexylamine complexes showed marked antileukemic activity in vivo and that the antitumor activity is closely correlated with the structures and flexibility of the complexes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new Pt complexes with high antitumor activity and high therapeutic index.
the preparation and antitumor activity of a large number of new Pt analogs.

the preparation of platinum(II), platinum(IV), and rhodium(III) complexes of 2-(aminomethy1) cyclohexy1amine, 2-(aminocarbony1) cyclohe xy1amine, 1,3-diphen1-1,3-propaned1amine, and 1,3-butaned1amine and their antitumour activity against leukaemia L1210 and P388.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the trans-l- and the cis-l- 2-(aminomethy) cyclohexamine complexes have a high antitumor activity.
cis-l-2-aminomethyl cyclohexylammonium platinum (II) complex was found to be the most active and the least toxic among the compounds tested.
the trans-l- and the cis-l- isomers are more effective than the other isomers, and that the 1, 4-diaminobutane isomer is more effective than the 1,3- and 1,2-diaminobutenes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cis-2-(amino-methyl) cyclo-hexylamine complex has a high antitumor activity and is a promising candidate for further study.
the cis-l- and trans-l-2- (aminomethyl) cyclcohexylamine platinum(II) complex is a promising new antitumor agent.
the cis-2-(amino-methyl) cyclo hexylamine complex is a promising candidate for clinical trials.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the antitumor activity of the cis-l and trans-l-2-aminomethylcyclohexylamine complexes is related to the structure of the complex.
platinum (II) analogs with a flexible structure are more active than those with a rigid structure.
the antitumor activity of the cis isomers is much higher than that of the corresponding trans isomers.
